mapper.select: select coalesce(round(sum(cs.actual_cost)), 0) as totalSalesAmount , coalesce(round(sum(case when cs.actual_start_time::date = current_date then cs.actual_cost end)), 0) as todaySalesAmount , coalesce(round(avg(cs.actual_cost)), 0) as "avgPaymentAmount" , coalesce(sum(cs.actual_kwh), 0) as "totalKwh" , ( coalesce(round(sum(case when cs.actual_start_time::date = current_date then cs.actual_cost end)), 0) - coalesce(round(sum(case when cs.actual_start_time::date = current_date - interval '1 day' then cs.actual_cost end)), 0) ) as diffSalesAmount from charging_session cs join charger c on cs.charger_id = c.charger_id join charging_station st on c.station_id = st.station_id where

select to_char(cs.actual_start_time::date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as salesDate , coalesce(round(sum(cs.actual_cost)), 0) as salesAmount , count(*) as "paymentCount" , coalesce(round(avg(cs.actual_cost)), 0) as "avgPaymentAmount" from charging_session cs join charger c on cs.charger_id = c.charger_id join charging_station st on c.station_id = st.station_id where group by cs.actual_start_time::date order by cs.actual_start_time::date

select to_char(cs.actual_start_time, 'HH24') as salesHour , coalesce(round(sum(cs.actual_cost)), 0) as salesAmount , count(*) as "paymentCount" , coalesce(round(avg(cs.actual_cost)), 0) as "avgPaymentAmount" , coalesce(sum(cs.actual_kwh), 0) as "totalKwh" from charging_session cs join charger c on cs.charger_id = c.charger_id join charging_station st on c.station_id = st.station_id where group by to_char(cs.actual_start_time, 'HH24') order by salesHour

select c.charger_type as chargerType , coalesce(round(sum(cs.actual_cost)), 0) as salesAmount , coalesce(round(sum(cs.actual_cost) * 100.0 / nullif(sum(sum(cs.actual_cost)) over(), 0), 1), 0) as salesRate from charging_session cs join charger c on cs.charger_id = c.charger_id join charging_station st on c.station_id = st.station_id where group by c.charger_type order by salesAmount desc

select row_number() over(order by station_sales.sales_amount desc) as rankNo , station_sales.station_id as stationId , station_sales.station_name as stationName , station_sales.sales_amount as salesAmount , station_sales.payment_count as "paymentCount" , station_sales.total_kwh as "totalKwh" , station_sales.avg_payment_amount as "avgPaymentAmount" , coalesce(round(station_sales.sales_amount * 100.0 / nullif(sum(station_sales.sales_amount) over(), 0), 1), 0) as salesRate from ( select st.station_id , st.station_name , coalesce(round(sum(cs.actual_cost)), 0) as sales_amount , count(*) as payment_count , coalesce(sum(cs.actual_kwh), 0) as total_kwh , coalesce(round(avg(cs.actual_cost)), 0) as avg_payment_amount from charging_session cs join charger c on cs.charger_id = c.charger_id join charging_station st on c.station_id = st.station_id where group by st.station_id, st.station_name ) station_sales order by salesAmount desc limit 10

select cs.session_id as sessionId , to_char(cs.actual_start_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as paymentDate , m.member_name as memberName , st.station_name as stationName , c.charger_name as chargerName , cs.actual_kwh as actualKwh , cs.actual_minutes as actualMinutes , round(cs.actual_cost) as actualCost , cs.status as status from charging_session cs join app_member m on cs.member_id = m.member_id join charger c on cs.charger_id = c.charger_id join charging_station st on c.station_id = st.station_id where order by cs.actual_start_time desc limit 200
